The Bachelor’s degree programme in Business Economics and Organization (BEO, degree class L18) is taught entirely in English

notes: Tuition left out on purpose: for non-EU citizens residing abroad the Manifesto degli studi 2025-2026 states only "Il contributo unico per tutti i Corsi di Laurea dei Dipartimenti di “Scienze Giuridiche e dell’Impresa”, “Management, Finanza e Tecnologie” ed “Ingegneria” è di €7.500/00 ... dovrà essere corrisposto in rata unica", which is an institution-wide figure covering several degree programmes (not this programme alone) and is the same amount charged to ordinary students (€5.500/00 total for L-18/L-18R in the rate table), so it is not a distinct fee stated for a non-EU applicant; no quote ties this programme to a tuition group and no country-group list naming Morocco was found. The only amount directly tied to this programme's degree class (L-18/L-18R: €5.500,00 total contributo unico) is paid in instalments and is not stated as the fee for a non-EU applicant, so it was not used. Deadline left out: the only application period given (immatricolazioni 09 GIUGNO 2025 – 31 ottobre 2025) is tied to the 2025/26 academic year, not 2026/27 or 2027/28. Application channel left out: no page names Universitaly; the only portal named is the university's own area "MYLUM".
